name: Niara Lover
source:
It is a tale about the legend of a slave and a wolf.

Niara is a young slave who endures great suffering;
During one of her attempts to escape, she makes a close friend: a wolf with beautiful green eyes. Together, they will protect one another and learn that they are stronger united.

[Translated from [url=https://estudiosmlv.itch.io/niara-lover]Itch.io[/url]]
